about_the_game:
Welcome to the job of a Farmer! A regular farm, plant, grow fruits and vegetables and sell them. Ordinary work, it would seem.... BUT NOT ON THIS FARM! What? Fruit with legs? Apple smiles? Pear barks? (not true).

Meet, the most chaotic farm ever! Forget about quiet gardening and growing plants - your fruits and vegetables have declared independence! Try to catch them in every possible way and as fast as possible, for the sake of getting further in this cruel life!

"My Farm Is Running!" will throw you into a hilariously frantic and silly chase after your unruly crop before it disappears over the horizon. Your farm, it is literally RUNNING!!! (did you get the joke?? heheheheheh)

FEATURES:

  • FRUITS AND VEGETABLES (with legs): Chase down a vibrant cast of cheeky, anthropomorphic plants – speedy green apples, annoying oranges, cloning pears, and more! Each has its own personality (and running style!).

  • RABID FARM FIELDS: Sprint through a variety of exciting levels, filled with different objectives! Obstacles and surprises keep every chase fresh and frantic.

  • AGAINST THE CLOCK: Time is ALWAYS ticking! Master quick reflexes, smart paths, and daring dives to catch 'em all before the timer runs out.

  • GROW YOUR FARM: Complete objectives, to earn gold and unlock new levels! Buy new upgrades, unlock helpful farmer tools with the gold.

Ready to the most unexpected harvest season ever?

Prepare yourself – Your crops won't catch themselves!

short_description: Experience farm life like never before – where the crops are the ones doing the harvesting... of their freedom! Chase down your escaping produce in a madcap, silly dash to save your livelihood.
